thread:
maya: Heads-up — launching the "Benchmarks & Webinars" push next Thursday. Need coordinated X (2-thread + single post) and LinkedIn (article + 3-post thread) schedule, plus webinar CTA asset. Draft schedule below — need copy + hero assets + SDR routing by EOD Tue.

leon: Can we hit 9am PT on launch day for the main X post? historically highest engagement. Also need UTM params for each variant.

sam: Putting up copy drafts here. Short X alt A/B + longer LinkedIn post. Feedback pls.
```
X A: Redwood Inference makes LLMs predictable at scale — faster, cheaper, reliable. Join our webinar to see it in action. Register: https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_campaign=bench-webinar&utm_medium=x&utm_source=a
X B: Serving LLMs should be predictable. Watch how Redwood balances latency and cost — live demo + benchmarks. Register: https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_campaign=bench-webinar&utm_medium=x&utm_source=b
LinkedIn: Benchmarks matter. In our upcoming webinar we share real app traces: latency, cost-per-token, and rollout lessons. RSVP + deep dive. https://redwood.com/webinar
```

anya: Assets update — hero gif done. Exporting two static crops: 1200x628 and 800x800. Will finish Monday noon. Need a square crop for X thread images. Links once uploaded.

jules: Routing note — please tag leads with campaign=bench-webinar and route to SDR queue #2. @sdr-bot can you confirm webhook mapping to HubSpot and that form submissions carry source tags?

sdr-bot: Confirmed. Webhook -> HubSpot list "Bench Webinar 04-2026", mapping uses email->contact, metadata includes utm_campaign & source. Test run scheduled Wed 10:30am PT.

leon: Metrics to track: CTR, registration rate, CPL, and thread engagement (replies/shares). We'll run A/B on X copy and measure registration lift. Sam, add unique UTM for each variant.

maya: Engagement follow-ups: propose 2 scripted replies per thread to re-engage commenters and route hot leads to SDRs. Sam/Jules — can you draft the scripts? Also need a one-line for comms to send to SEs so they can amplify.

sam: Draft replies below, will add in scheduling doc and tag variants.
```
reply A: Thanks — love the interest! Drop your email or DM and we'll schedule a quick demo.
reply B: Appreciate the question — we've got a short walkthrough here: https://cal.com/redwood/demo?utm_campaign=bench-webinar&utm_source=reply
```

anya: Uploading assets to s3:/marketing/bench-webinar/ named hero1.gif, hero1-1200x628.jpg, hero1-800x800.jpg. Preview link: https://staging.redwoodassets/s/bench-hero1 (will replace w/ final CDN).

jules: I will run the HubSpot test Wed and confirm mapping + flow. Also creating an SDR playbook snippet for quick handoffs (hot lead = requested demo or left contact in thread).

maya: Final asks: Sam finalize copy by Tue 11am PT, Anya confirm final crops by Mon noon, Jules confirm SDR mapping + test by Wed EOD. I’ll pin the schedule in #marketing-calendar and drop a note to comms list after assets are live. :rocket:

leon: LGTM — thanks everyone. Quick ask: include a short benchmark blurb we can use as a hook on LinkedIn (1-2 lines with numbers). Sam, can you add that to the doc?

sam: On it — adding a 1-line stat and a short thread opener. Will post link to the draft doc when done.
